messages.subject: BMW Group Thailand | EV transition, Rayong manufacturing and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Joo and BMW Group Thailand Leadership Team,

BMW Group Thailand's combination of premium mobility, EV growth and manufacturing in Rayong creates a strong match with my experience in regulated industrial operations, sustainability and government-facing execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and senior stakeholder strategy. I coordinate across operating, technical and corporate functions while maintaining direct interfaces with public institutions and external stakeholders.

I would bring BMW a practical industrial-transition perspective. My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, carbon-data readiness based on operating evidence, and cross-functional management of environmental, regulatory and community priorities. This experience aligns with the institutional work surrounding sustainable manufacturing, electrification and investment.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN leadership roles across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a BMW Group Thailand-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to Ms. Yangye Kris Joo or the relevant executive talent team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
